column3: Sluggish start - settled at back of field - moved right and made progress from 2f out - hit front inside final two furlongs - drew away to win easily

Settled into midfield after fighting for control early - crept into contention after three furlongs - pushed forward to challenge for the front two out - overtaken with a furlong left - drifted right and unable to reel in winner close home finishing second
Went straight to front early - held a forward spot before hitting traffic 2f out - stayed on at one gear through the last furlong - caught for third close home
Settled at the back early - pushed along and made progress wide entering final furlong - stayed on to close down third close home
Settled close to the pace early - hit the front after 1f then lost command 2f out - gave way inside the final furlong
Settled close to the pace - still in contention with two furlongs left - lost momentum inside the closing stages to finish sixth
Settled just behind the pace pulling hard early - eased back a fraction after 3f - pushed along 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 7th
Sluggish start - stayed at the back throughout - well held in 8th
Handy in the early running - moved left and hit the front approaching 2f out - stayed on strongly through the closing stages to win
Fractious pre-off - settled towards back - progress from 2f out to move into second inside final furlong - unable to reel in winner and held for runner-up
Struggling for pace at the back - found extra gears inside final two furlongs - closed on second but couldn't reach the leader - stayed on to finish third
Held a midfield position - shifted right and pushed along with 2f left then poised near the front past the furlong marker - held safe finished fourth beaten 5.5 lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along with a furlong to go but unable to close - dropped away near the finish
Sent to front early - lost command approaching final quarter mile - dropped away inside last furlong to finish sixth
Tracked leaders on the rail - hit the front 4f out then overtaken 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong

Sat handy behind the front group - improved into second after the 6th and made ground 4 out - asked for effort before 3 out - hit the front approaching 2 out - kept finding under pressure to prevail by a whisker at the line
Held up towards the back - improved into contention before 3 out - driven approaching 2 out - shared fourth over the last - flat out from 110yds out and edged clear late but caught right on the line
Error early on - settled midfield then moved up to third by the 7th - urged on approaching 3 out - still in with hope at the last - stayed on same gait to finish third
Settled in the pack early - hit the 5th before moving into third - pressed with a couple out then kept on same gear to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - improved to share third 4 out under pressure - unable to find more from 2 out and well held at the finish
Settled towards the back - nudged into contention before 3 out - unable to sustain effort 2 out - eventually finished 6th
Sent to front early - opened up a big advantage after the 6th - margin narrowed by four out - driven on three out - overtaken before two out then lost touch and beaten before the last
Settled towards the back - made some headway 4 out under a drive - lost ground quickly before the following fence - well held in 8th
Sat close to the front group early - lost touch in a hurry approaching 4 out - beaten a long way in 9th
Prominent early and tracking pace-setter before the 4th - drifted back through the pack after 6th - needed encouragement by the 8th - dropped away 4 out and eased to a halt
Settled in the pack - urged forward approaching final 2 furlongs - moved into second inside the last furlong - took command close home and stayed on to win
Went to the front early - driven on turning for home and asked for more with a furlong left - lost the advantage close home - stayed on at a single gear to finish second
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - moved to the wide side approaching the furlong pole - stayed on to snatch third right at the line
Sat behind the pace - disputed second at halfway - asked for effort into the final two furlongs and found little - eased back to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - driven wide 2f out and up to 6th with a furlong left - one-paced through the closing stages to finish fifth
Settled midfield early - urged on the rail entering the straight - driven into 4th a furlong out - faded in the final stages to finish 6th
Held up towards the back - moved forward wide to reach the pace 2f out - pressed for effort in 5th before losing momentum inside the final furlong - dropped away to finish 7th
Sat close to pace early - 5th at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left but found nothing more - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 8th
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout - finished 9th
Sat close to front pair - third at halfway - urged into effort 3f out but couldn't find more - dropped away 2f out to finish tenth
Settled at the back early - unable to land a blow - well held in 11th
Sat close to front pack early - up in 4th at halfway - asked for effort 3f out and soon lost momentum to finish well held
Raced eagerly in the pack early - moved across and made progress with 2f left - edged to the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Sat behind the pace - pressed forward a furlong out and looked set to strike inside the final furlong - edged out close home
Settled in the pack - moved through to challenge with 2f left and looked a threat inside final furlong - edged out close home to finish third
Fought for control early - hit front before being overtaken with 5f left - shifted course right approaching final 2f - unable to find more inside last 110 yards and finished fourth
Sluggish start - tracked front rank before angling right over 2f out - couldn't quicken from over 1f out and held for fifth
Settled midfield early - fought for control under restraint - shortened the gap late without getting on terms - finished sixth beaten 5 1/4 lengths
Settled towards the back - urged forward with 2f to go - nudged into the pack late but not good enough - finished 7th
Settled close to the pace early - hit the front with 5f remaining then lost that advantage inside the last furlong and faded to finish 8th
Settled at the back - angled right and made progress a furlong out - lost ground close home
Poor break and settled at back - improved position with a furlong left - lost ground close home to finish 10th
Sluggish start - held up towards the back for most of the contest - never a factor - well held in 11th
Raced handy on the outer - in contention until 2f out - dropped away with over a furlong left - eventually well held
Held up in the pack - unable to land a blow - well held in 13th
Settled at rear early - up into 3rd 3 out - pressed but couldn't get closer to pace - inherited lead at last and idled home unchallenged
Contesting the front spot early - clear from three out - challenged at the second-last but shook that off again - two lengths to the good and going strong when came down at the final fence

Sat close up in third early - moved into second three out - shared advantage for a stride two out before being overtaken and needing urging - was left clear again in the closing stages but fell at the final obstacle
Shared front spot - came down three out
Sat close to the pace early - moved up on the leading duo three out - pushed along two out - took command inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly to win

Visibly on edge early - tracked leading pair in second - edged in front by a whisker before being tested from 3 out - driven approaching final two furlongs - fought back run-in but overtaken close home and unable to find more
Went straight to front - lost command 3 out but stayed on terms with pace - pushed along 2 out - faded in closing stages to finish third
Held up towards the back - urged forward to reach contention before 3 out - up into fourth 2 out but only able to plod on to the line
Held up towards the back - urged forward after 4 out - dropped away 3 out - finished 5th
Settled in the middle of the pack - dropped away and under pressure 4 out - eventually well detached at the finish
Settled in the pack early - faltered and was withdrawn from contention after the 1st
Settled in the pack - made headway approaching 3 out and was travelling well without pressure into contention - fell 2 out
Settled just behind the pace - 4th at halfway - hemmed in approaching 2f out before finding room out wide - drove to the front inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Sat close to the front group - asked for effort in the early straight - squeezed for space in 4th with a furlong left - moved into 2nd close home and stayed on at one speed
Slow to begin - settled midfield - urged on turning into straight - improved to 6th a furlong out - stayed on to snatch 3rd late
Settled in the pack early - moved into contention by halfway - urged forward to challenge into the straight - lost the advantage a furlong out and found nothing more - eased back to finish fourth
Sat behind pace early - second at halfway - moved up to share advantage entering straight - pressed but slipped back a furlong out - eased away from placings to finish fifth
Held up towards back of pack - improved wide to close on pace setters over 2f out but flattened out under pressure into 5th - dropped back again close home finishing sixth
Sat behind front group - asked for effort on inner 2f out but found little more - stayed on same gear to finish seventh
Sent clear early - under pressure and overtaken entering the straight - driven and faded inside the final furlong
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort wide of rivals with two furlongs left - asked for more soon after but couldn't quicken from a furlong out - finished well held
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout
Held up in the pack from the off - unable to make an impression - finished well beaten in 11th
Sat close to the pace early - 3rd at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but faded from there
Held up towards the back - crept into the pack by halfway - dropped away 2f out - finished well beaten in 13th
Handy early - hit front with a furlong left drifting right approaching the line - stayed on strongly to score
Went straight to front - lost lead 6f out but remained close up - pushed along on inner 2f out - unable to reel in leader inside final furlong and a bit - battled on for second
Settled handy off the pace on the outside - hit the front and switched across 6f out - overtaken inside final furlong but stayed on well for 3rd
Raced close up early - stayed within range through the pack - found extra inside final furlong to finish fourth
Went forward in front early - settled among the pack through the middle stages - lost ground with a furlong remaining and finished without threatening
Settled at back of field - clipped heels approaching 5f out - pushed along inside final furlong but never featured in finish
Sluggish start - fought for control early - settled at back of field - pushed along wide entering final furlong but couldn't land a blow - finished well held in 7th
Held up towards back of pack - progress to 6th three out - driven after following fence and edged to front approaching last - kept going strongly to score

Sat close to the front group early - fourth with three furlongs left - pressed for effort after the following fence - up to second by the final obstacle and stayed on at an even effort to finish second
Held up towards the back - still down in 8th three out and pushed along - moved up into 4th but hampered at the last - 3rd inside the final furlong - stayed on for the minor placing
Held up in midpack - still 7th with 3 to go and pushed along soon after - up to 5th approaching the last - stayed on for 4th but never landed a blow
Held up in the pack - still 9th 3 out - pushed along before the last - up to 6th at the finish but found little more
Went straight to the front - stumbled at the 3rd - pushed along after the second-last - overtaken near the final flight and held on run-in for 6th
Held up towards the back - blunder at the 2nd - still down the field 3 out and unable to close - well held in 7th
Sat close up in second early - pushed along two out but unable to close - dropped away late - finished 8th beaten a long way
Settled around midfield - improved into third with 3 to go - dropped away final furlongs to finish well beaten
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 3rd after 3 out - dropped away late to finish 10th
Settled around midfield - improved into 5th with three furlongs left before being pressed for effort - dropped away and finished well beaten in 11th
Settled midpack early - stumbled and needed urging 3rd before slipping to the back - lost touch from 4 out - eased and withdrawn before the final two furlongs
Sat close to the pace early - lost touch four out and dropped away - eased down and pulled up before the final fence
Held up early - crept through easily 3 out to lead just after 2 out - pushed clear on the run to the line though wandering left and won

Tracked the pace early - dropped back after 4 out - regained ground before 3 out to share second - asked for effort and found little 2 out - fought back inside final furlong but held for a length runner-up spot
Held up in the pack - improved to move into third before 3 out - chased the front-runner 2 out - driven out but couldn't threaten the winner and slipped back to finish third
Went straight to front but keen and unwilling to relax - driven on approaching 3 out - overtaken 2 out - stumbled at final fence then held on steadily to finish fourth
Sat behind the pack early - scratchy over one obstacle in 3rd - improved into 4th - moved up to second after 4 out - dropped back and driven 3 out - faded before the finish
Settled in the pack early - dropped away and adrift of the field before veering off line 3 out - well held at the finish
Sat behind the front group - 4th at halfway - driven forward down the inner - hit the front a furlong out and stayed on strongly to the line
Held up towards the back - closed onto the front group with 2f left - urged into 4th with a furlong to run - forced up into 2nd close home before staying on at one speed
Set the tempo - driven entering the straight - caught and passed over 1f out - plugged on at one speed to finish 3rd
Sat behind the front group - urged forward with 2f left before moving into 4th approaching the final 200 yards - unable to find more and stayed on at same rate to finish 4th
Held up towards back of pack - urged into effort with over 2f left - pressed for late response inside final furlong - stayed on to snatch 5th at the finish
Sat behind the front group early - third at halfway - urged into second at the start of the straight but found little more - faded to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - improved into midfield over 2f out then found little from a furlong out - stayed on same gait to finish 7th
Held up in the pack - urged forward with two furlongs left - asked for effort soon after and stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong - eventually finished eighth
Sat close behind pace - second at halfway - third and driven early in straight - faded final furlong to finish ninth
Held up at the back - driven approaching 2f out - unable to make headway from inside final furlong - well held at the finish
Sat close to the pace - 5th at halfway - driven with 2f left then found nothing and faded
Settled around midfield - slipped towards the back with 2f left - unable to threaten leading pair - well held at the line
Held up in the pack - driven on the rail with 4f left - faded from there to finish well beaten in 13th
Held up at the back - no impact - well held throughout
Settled close up early - moved into second before a furlong gone then edged in front with just over a furlong left - held on strongly to the line for victory
Went straight to front - lost advantage inside final furlong - stayed on to finish second beaten three quarters of a length
Pulled hard early settling just behind the pace - eased back to third after a furlong - drifted right under pressure inside final 2f - unable to close on leading duo late finishing third
Slowly away and settled at the back - ridden to make progress from 3f out - stayed on inside the final furlong without threatening the front rank
Sat close to pace early - moved into second three out - hit front at the following fence - shaken up to open a gap - kept finding through the run-in for a comfortable win
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along into 3rd two out and up into runner-up spot before the last - stayed on late but no danger to winner
Settled in 5th just off the pace - pushed along four out - up into 4th two out without threatening those ahead - moved into 3rd approaching the last - held that spot to finish third
Went straight to front early - lost sole command 3rd before losing lead 5 out - pushed along in 5th 3 out - up to 4th at final fence but held that spot without finding more - beaten well into 4th
Settled towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway from 4 out - dropped away steadily to finish well behind
Settled second early - shared front spot at 3rd - went in front 5 out - pushed along and overtaken 2 out with nothing left in reply - slipped to fourth then fell at the last
Held up towards the back - blunder at 1st - errors 3rd and rider parted company
Settled in the pack - 6th 3 out then lost touch - pulled up before the last
Settled towards the back - jinked left and lost rider at the 3rd
Led from the off - stretched clear after 4 out - challenged approaching 3 out - locked in battle with rival from 2 out - driven out to prevail
Handy in the front rank - asked for effort before 3 out and up alongside the front-runner - battled with the winner from 2 out to the line - fought on well but narrowly denied
Settled in the central pack - moved up to third four out - nudged forward approaching three out - kept on but a clumsy jump at the last and never threatened
Held a midfield spot early - jumped awkwardly around the fifth - improved into fourth two out - kept on to the line without getting near the front
Held up towards the back - urged to keep tempo in 5th - stayed on from 3 out - shortened gap late but always outpaced
Settled in the pack - stumbled at the 4th then driven for effort before 3 out - dropped away before 2 out to finish 6th
Held up towards the back - driven along before halfway - dropping away 4 out and well beaten at the finish
Well placed early - faded 4 out - beaten a long way by the finish
Settled midpack early - urged into effort in 5th and began fading - dropped right away - eased and pulled up after 4 out
Sat close to the front pack - asked for effort over 2f out - moved up inside to challenge early in straight - hit front a furlong out - held on under renewed pressure close home to prevail

Settled towards the back of the pack - improved into 7th by halfway - moved up wide to join the front group over 2f out - asked for effort in 3rd early in the straight - driven into 2nd inside the final furlong - challenged the front-runner approaching the final 100 yards but couldn't find more late
Held up towards the back early - improved into midfield 3f out - driven wide entering the straight - still 7th with a furlong left - stayed on late to snatch 3rd
Held a midfield position early - asked for effort with over 2f left and improved into 6th approaching the final furlong - stayed on well through the closing stages to snatch 4th right at the line
Went straight to the front - urged forward early in the straight and gave up the advantage inside the final furlong - held steady in third with nothing more to give - eased back to finish fifth
Sat behind the front group early - 4th at halfway - urged into effort with two furlongs left - lost place late and dropped out for sixth
Sat close to the front group - 5th at halfway - urged to improve into 4th over 1f out - had nothing more and faded close home
Held up in the pack from the off - unable to make an impression through the middle stages - well held at the finish
Slow into stride - held up at the back - made no impression - finished ninth
Sat close up early - disputed second at halfway - urged for effort 3f out but couldn't quicken - dropped away inside final 2f
Sat close to the front pack early - third at halfway then driven with 3f left - faded without response late
Held up at the back - no impression made through the contest - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - asked for effort with 3f left - unable to close - well held at the finish
Settled among the pack early - made progress from 2f out to move into second inside the final furlong - hit the front close home - stayed on to win
Fought for control early - shadowed the pace-setter - hit the front a furlong out but overtaken approaching the final furlong - battled back yet narrowly denied at the line
Settled towards the back early - began to close in final furlong - up into third close home - stayed on well to finish third
Front early - lost command approaching final furlong - couldn't find more late - held on for 4th
Settled towards back of field - shaped up late inside final furlong - never a threat to front-runners - finished 5th
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort with 2f left - faded and dropped back inside final furlong - finished sixth
Sat close to the front group - shifted left and clipped another runner with 2f remaining - lost momentum inside the final furlong - finished seventh
Settled towards the back early - improved position wide 3f from home - couldn't quicken and made no dent on the leaders inside the final furlong - finished eighth
held up in the pack - nudged closer approaching final furlong - unable to land a blow at the finish
Held up in midfield - lost place from over 2f out - dropped away final stages - finished well held
Tardy leaving the stalls - made progress and prominent on the outer while pulling hard 6f out - nudged aside 2f out and dropped out of contention
Hesitant leaving the gate - rookie-looking throughout - held off the pace for the whole trip - finished well held in 12th
Settled towards back of the pack - improved into 7th two out - asked for effort soon after - challenging in 3rd approaching last - hit front inside final furlong and kept on strongly

Settled just behind the pace early - hit the front approaching 4th - drew level 4 out then lost the advantage - pushed along and back to 3rd 2 out - still 3rd entering the final furlong - stayed on to take second at the line
Held up in last - nudged forward from 5th - galvanised 4 out then 2 out - stayed on into 6th at the last and into 3rd at the line but never competitive enough to challenge
Sat behind pace early - moved through to hit front two out and got asked for effort - wandered slightly nearing last - overtaken inside final furlong - unable to find more and held on for 4th
Held up early - progress to 6th 3f out - pushed along and moved into 2nd before the last - unable to find more on the run-in finishing 5th
Held up near the back - urged into contention in 10th two out - stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along and slipped back to 8th two out - unable to close late - finished 7th
Held up at back - still 11th three out then driven into contention - 8th at the last with no real threat
Settled in the pack early - moved into 4th 3 out and into 3rd after the second-last - lost ground on the run-in to finish 9th
Settled in the pack - pushed along in 9th approaching final two furlongs - unable to close - finished well held in 10th
Went straight to the front - lost that spot at the 4th - fought back into contention 4 out - back in command 3 out - overhauled after and soon driven along before fading well held
Settled around midpack - unable to close from 3 out - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Sat close up early - nearly stumbled at the 5th - pushed along 3 out and lost touch - down in 10th when came to grief at the final fence

Sprinted straight to a big advantage from the off - held a huge margin at halfway - twenty lengths to the good with four furlongs remaining - driven out inside the final furlong - stayed on to win unopposed
Held up in the pack - moved into a remote second spot 2f out - never able to close on the winner and finished 15 lengths back
Held up early - improved position 3f out - driven into third inside final furlong but unable to quicken
Settled midfield as one broke away out front - urged forward with over 3f remaining - unable to close the gap - finished fourth well beaten
Sat close behind front-runner - urged forward 3f out - lost ground 2f out - finished 5th well beaten
Held up in the pack - nudged for effort 3f out - found nothing - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort with three furlongs left - made no impact - finished seventh
Sat close behind the front-runner - urged forward with over 2f left - soon lost touch and beaten - finished 8th
Jinked left sharply at the off - dislodged rider
Held up at the back - urged forward entering the straight then eased to the outside inside the final two furlongs - responded to riding and finished strongly - got up close home to score
Held a midfield spot - 6th at halfway - driven up under pressure over 2f out to hit the front inside the final furlong - couldn't quicken and was overtaken near the finish to place 2nd
Sat behind front group early - 4th at halfway - urged on turning into straight - 3rd a furlong out and up to 2nd with 100 yards left - faded to finish 3rd
Held up at the back of the pack - urged forward with over 2f left - driven wide with a furlong to run - stayed on late to grab 4th near the line

Tracked the pace-setter - third at halfway - driven on the rail approaching 2f out - squeezed for space in 4th with a furlong left - responded inside the final furlong but had nothing more late and faded to finish 5th
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final 2f with little response - stayed on same rate to the line finishing sixth
Towards the back of the field - asked for effort over 2f out but found little - stayed on same gait to finish 7th
Settled behind pace - second at halfway - driven approaching straight - hit front a furlong out - overtaken 150 yards out and faded near the line
Set the pace early - driven approaching straight and lost front spot inside final furlong - faded quickly and finished well held
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout - finished 10th
Knocked in the early scrimmage - settled towards the back - made ground wide of rivals from 2f out - edged in front inside the last furlong - repelled a late rally to prevail by a whisker

Knocked into opponent when drifted right at the break - held up towards the back - made progress up the far flank from 2f out - shared the advantage entering the final furlong - pressed the winner inside the last 110yds - couldn't find more close home - held on for second
Slow to break - settled towards back - progress from 2f out - closed to grab third inside final furlong and stayed on well
Settled in the pack early - improved widest of them on the approach to the final furlong - moved into fourth close home - stayed on to finish 4th beaten 2 lengths
Handy in the pack early - driven with a furlong left then lost ground inside final 110 yards - dropped away quickly at the finish
Handy early - driven approaching 2f out and lost ground inside final furlong - responded late to stay on one gear to the line
Set the pace from the off - driven to keep clear 2f out - overtaken inside final two furlongs - dropped away in a hurry through the last furlong
Bumped at the start and carried left - settled second early - driven when dropping back 2f out - faded from over 1f out - drifted right and gave way fast approaching the final furlong
Handy up in the pack early - driven approaching 2f out to move into second - hit the top with a furlong left - stayed on strongly to score
Went straight to front - lost advantage briefly but stayed close early - back in command over 2f out - pressed and worn down inside final furlong - unable to find more late and held for second
Up with the front group on the rail - nudged into action over 2f out - angled right then left inside the final furlong - no match for the first two and finished third
Sluggish start - settled towards the back of the pack - encouraged into contention over 2f out - needed a lot more when asked for effort 1f out - responded to finish fourth and closing best of all
Tracked front pair early - pushed for effort with 3f left - lost touch soon after - rallied late but couldn't reach front-runners and faded to finish fifth

Settled towards the back early - lacked pace and needed more with 2f left - not competitive with the front group approaching the furlong marker - finished with modest late progress but always outside the frame
Sluggish start - settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along and lost touch inside final 2f - kept going close home - well held in 7th
Held up in the pack early - unable to improve position through the race - finished well held in 8th
Settled in the pack - pushed for effort 3f out - unable to land a blow late
Settled with eager enthusiasm early - tracked front pair - moved through to hit the front after 2f - overtaken 2f out - pushed for effort and faded inside final furlong
Settled midfield early - pushed for effort with 3f left - dropped away inside final 2f - finished well beaten in 11th
Fought for control early settling towards the back - never a factor thereafter - well held in 12th
Slow to break - stayed at the back throughout - well held in 13th
Sat second early - drifted back in second at halfway - urged forward three out - driven approaching final furlong - hit front at the last - stayed on to score
Took the initiative - forged far ahead from the 4th - serious jumping error 3 out - margin cut back after 2 out - passed at the last and one-paced on the run-in
Sat close to the front group early - urged into 4th 3 out - into 3rd under pressure 2 out - unable to threaten the front and stayed on same gear for 3rd
Settled in the pack early - crept into 3rd before pressed for effort 3 out then slipped to 4th - unable to close on the front-runners late
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort in 5th 3 out - unable to close - faded late to finish 5th
Sat close to the pace early - driven into 4th 4 out - dropped away 3 out and beaten a long way
Held up early - lost touch through the middle stages - well off the pace at the finish - beaten a long way
Held up in touch with back markers - error at the 2nd - well beaten when pulled up before the last
Held up at the back - still adrift of the field late on - eased and pulled up before the final fence
Handy in the pack early - hit the front at the 8th - pressed for effort approaching 2 out - pulled away on the run to the line
Settled midpack early - moved into third approaching 3 out - took second soon after - pushed along after 2 out and stayed on for second beaten 5 lengths
Held up in the pack - driven approaching two out and moved into third - kept on late but never a factor for victory
Set the pace early - lost the advantage at the 8th before being pushed along after 3 out - dropped away 2 out to finish 4th
Sat close to the front group early - pressed for progress after the second-last - dropped away soon after and held on for 5th
Settled just off the pace - knocked about at the 8th - pushed along after 3 out but unable to close - finished sixth well beaten
Settled towards the back - improved into contention before the 8th - pressed for effort after 3 out but faded before 2 out
Held up in the pack - pushed along after 3 out - dropped away quickly - well held at the finish
Settled at the back early - blundered 8th and lost touch after 3 out - eased out of contention approaching the second-last
Settled towards the back - lost touch after 7th - eased out of contention following 8th
Settled in the pack early - jostled at the 8th and slipped towards the back in trouble - eased out of contention approaching the second-last
Slow into stride at the first - settled in the pack - moved up to third four out - driven three out - forged to the front approaching the last - asserted decisively on the run-in to win
Settled towards the back - last of all before the 5th - made progress 4 out - among those vying for third at the last - driven out up the run-in and stayed on for second but no answer to the winner
Set the pace early - urged on before three out then lost top spot two out - driven but couldn't find more up the straight
Handy early - upped tempo after 4 out and edged closer - asked for effort 3 out - hit front 2 out - overtaken near last and held on for fourth
Sat close to leading duo - clipped first fence then driven and lost place 4 out - dropped away well held after finishing 5th
Held up at the back - made progress into fourth before the 5th but soon slipped back - dropped away 2 out to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - made progress into contention over 2f out - hit the front approaching the final furlong - kept going strongly to draw away close home
Not the smoothest getaway - soon in front - asked for effort with 3f left - overtaken inside the final furlong - stayed on for second
Set the pace early - still up with the front through the middle stages - well placed with a furlong to run - couldn't quicken past winner but stayed on to finish third
Tracked front group early - pressed for effort inside final furlong but failed to find extra gear - kept going without real turn of foot to finish fourth
Settled at the back early - shifted wide and made progress under 2f out - unable to challenge - finished 5th
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - lost ground inside the final furlong - finished sixth
